body_markdown: Company increased backlog to $1.3 billion by end of July and bolstered balance sheet; FAA cleared Alpha for return to flight Firefly Aerospace rang the Bell at the Nasdaq MarketSite on August 7, 2025. CEDAR PARK, Texas, Sept. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Firefly Aerospace (Nasdaq: FLY), a market leading space and defense technology company, today issued financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2025.
